recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white portrait of a male figure with a beard, positioned centrally with hands reaching toward the camera in a wide-angle perspective. The lower third features a solid black block containing bold, white, geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme foreground hands framing the central face
High-contrast white text against a solid black rectangular base
Vertical curtain folds in the background echoing the vertical strokes of the font
Low-key lighting creating deep shadows on the subject's clothing and background
coreInvariants: Solid black horizontal bar for text grounding

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically and horizontally; hands are scaled larger due to proximity to lens.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold white display text in the lower center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, follow the reaching arms outward to the hands, then drop to the heavy text block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the background and lower half provide high contrast for the white elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for background and clothing shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for typography and highlights on skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and fabric highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Mirroring of specific glyphs to create symmetry
Removal of internal counters in some characters to increase blockiness

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over a black rectangular mask

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same geometric sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, technical, and bold aesthetic of the display text.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white photo of a man with a beard wearing a dark jacket, reaching his hands toward the camera lens. The background is a dark, vertically pleated curtain. Use low-key lighting to emphasize shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black rectangle across the lower third. Place a large, ultra-bold, white geometric sans-serif title in the center of the rectangle. Below the rectangle, add two lines of centered, white, extended sans-serif text with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Are the hands significantly larger than the face due to perspective?
Is the main text blocky and geometric?
Is there a clear black bar behind the primary text?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black text bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific mirrored glyphs that form a brand identity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present.
Verify the text is legible against the black background.
Check that the wide-angle distortion feels intentional and dramatic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a wide-angle monochromatic portrait with a heavy geometric footer block for a gritty, urban aesthetic.
